bio_default: Tinkers with things. Mostly doesn't break them.
Reader, walker, sceptic of new tools.
Quiet hours. Loud convictions. Decent coffee.
Old enough to remember dialup. Patient about most things.
Reads more than posts. Posts more than expected.
bio_writer: Longform essays. Coffee first, sentences second. Print is not dead.
Writes about cities that no longer exist. Newsletter once a fortnight.
Magazine work, mostly. Fiction on the side, badly.
Three drafts before lunch, one good sentence by dinner.
bio_trader: Macro by day, charts by night. Suspicious of certainty.
Markets are stories told with numbers. Stays away from the loudest ones.
Risk-off most of the time. Cash is a position.
Reads central bank minutes for fun. Trades them less often.
bio_researcher: Citations, footnotes, the long view. Posting reluctantly.
Working on a paper that will not finish itself.
Reads the bibliography first. Trusts replication.
Lab time, library time, sleep when permitted.
Asks the question twice. Answers it once.
